scripts.build: npm run build -w @stampperk/shared && npm run build -w @stampperk/api && npm run build -w @stampperk/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @stampperk/shared && npm run build -w @stampperk/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @stampperk/shared && npm run build -w @stampperk/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @stampperk/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @stampperk/web --if-present
scripts.start:api: npm run prisma:migrate -w @stampperk/api && npm run start:prod -w @stampperk/api
